name: recall_memory
description: Search your long-term memory for facts that are not shown to you already. Returns matching facts with their id, kind, date and text.

query.description: Words to look for. Leave empty to list the newest facts.

limit.description: How many facts at most (default 20, max 50).

name: update_memory
description: Save one fact to your long-term memory, or forget one. To correct a fact: forget it, then write the new one.

kind.description: For write: profile = lasting fact, journal = dated history.

fact.description: For write: the fact, one or two sentences.

scope.description: For write, optional: bot = only you, shared = all the user's bots.

expires.description: For write, optional: a date like 2026-12-31 after which the fact no longer applies.

id.description: For forget: the id shown in brackets before the fact.
